chunks.text: Short study breaks can help learners maintain focus during long study sessions.
A practical study routine is to take a five-minute break after each twenty-five-minute focus period.
Active recall means retrieving information from memory instead of only rereading notes.
Spaced review revisits information over increasing intervals to support long-term retention.

examples.query: How long is the break in the example study routine?
examples.reference_answer: The example routine uses a five-minute break after each twenty-five-minute focus period.
